notes: R_avg: bounce average of R over the |sin chi| distribution of the detected light; R_eff: exp(<ln R>) (sets T)
design: odd quarter-wave orders m_gap, m_tooth at sin chi = s1 (second half of the periods at s2 for two-band), linear chirp of both thicknesses; thicknesses in nm
period_over_lambda < 0.5: first-order mirror, stop-band Bloch mode below the light line (no radiating orders)
diffraction: isolated-gap bound (every air-gap traversal loses 1 - eta of the power, eta from the exact scalar angular-spectrum propagation of the TM0 profile); pessimistic, see qs/mirror.py
